title: #057. Vehicle Routing with Time Windows (VRPTW)
subtitle: Schedule up to K depot-based routes serving every customer within [earliest, latest] time windows using Big-M arrival linking.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { routes, totalCost }.
judge.m1: Field "routes" must be an array of routes.
judge.m3: Route {p0} must be an integer array of length at least 3 ([0, ..., 0]).
judge.m4: Route {p0} must start and end at depot 0.
judge.m5: Customer index {p0} is out of valid range [1, {p1}].
judge.m6: Customer {p0} is visited more than once.
judge.m7: Customer {p0} earliest feasible start ({p1}) exceeds latest window ({p2}).
judge.m8: Route {p0} returns to depot at {p1}, exceeding depot closing time ({p2}).
judge.m9: Customer {p0} was not visited by any route.
judge.m10: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed route travel cost ({p1}).
judge.m11: Time-window feasible routes, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
